import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, pixels_to_world, project

def geom(g):
    return dict(center=list(np.asarray(g.center_xyz_m, float)),
                ext=list(np.asarray(g.extent_xyz_m, float)),
                support_z=float(g.support_z_m),
                h=float(g.height_above_support_m),
                status=g.status)

def find_cup(cam="head", text="white cup with cookies"):
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera=cam, text=text, max_candidates=3)
    res = r["result"]
    cands = res.get("candidates", [])
    if not cands:
        return None, r
    c = cands[0]
    g = object_geometry(c)
    return c, g

c, g = find_cup()
print("cup cand bbox", c["bbox_xyxy"])
print("cup geom", geom(g))
bb = c["bbox_xyxy"]
uv = [[(bb[0]+bb[2])/2.0, (bb[1]+bb[3])/2.0]]
p = pixels_to_world("head", uv)[0]
print("cup pixel", uv, "world", p.xyz.tolist(), "valid", p.valid)

# belt surface depth probe: sample some pixels on the dark grey belt area
for v in [80, 120, 200, 300, 340]:
    ps = pixels_to_world("head", [[160.0, float(v)], [480.0, float(v)]])
    print("belt sample v", v, [x.xyz.tolist() for x in ps], [x.valid for x in ps])

obs = current()
p0 = p
for i in range(4):
    r = tools.wait_ticks(ticks=1)
    print("wait", i, r.ok, r.status, r.get("remaining_budget") if hasattr(r,'get') else "")
    c2, g2 = find_cup()
    if c2 is None:
        print("cup lost")
        break
    bb2 = c2["bbox_xyxy"]
    uv2 = [[(bb2[0]+bb2[2])/2.0, (bb2[1]+bb2[3])/2.0]]
    p2 = pixels_to_world("head", uv2)[0]
    print("  bbox", bb2, "world", p2.xyz.tolist(), "delta", (np.asarray(p2.xyz)-np.asarray(p0.xyz)).tolist())
    print("  geom", geom(g2))
    p0 = p2

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def quat_from_axes(approach, jaw_line):
    """world directions (3,) -> xyzw quaternion for tcp frame with x=approach, y=jaw_line, z=x cross y"""
    x = np.asarray(approach, float); x = x/np.linalg.norm(x)
    y = np.asarray(jaw_line, float); y = y - x*np.dot(x, y); y = y/np.linalg.norm(y)
    z = np.cross(x, y)
    R = np.column_stack([x, y, z])
    q = Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_quat()   # xyzw
    return q

DOWN = [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
JAW_X = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]

import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, Direction, Point
from ora_lib import geometry as G
from poses import flange_for, probe

def circle_fit(xy):
    x = xy[:,0]; y = xy[:,1]
    A = np.column_stack([2*x, 2*y, np.ones(len(x))])
    b = x*x + y*y
    sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
    cx, cy = sol[0], sol[1]
    r = np.sqrt(sol[2] + cx*cx + cy*cy)
    return cx, cy, r

obs = current()
print("step", obs.step)
gr = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="white cup with cookie top", max_candidates=3)
cand = None
for c in gr["result"]["candidates"]:
    g = object_geometry(c)
    try:
        cc = np.asarray(g.center_xyz_m, float)
    except Exception:
        continue
    print("cand", c["candidate_id"], c["bbox_xyxy"], "ctr", np.round(cc,4).tolist(),
          "ext", None if g.extent_xyz_m is None else np.round(np.asarray(g.extent_xyz_m,float),4).tolist(),
          "h", None if g.height_above_support_m is None else round(float(g.height_above_support_m),4))
    if abs(cc[0] + 0.09) < 0.10 and (g.height_above_support_m or 0) > 0.07:
        cand = c
if cand is None:
    handoff("cup not localized")
tgt = obs.target(cand["target_ref"])
mask = np.asarray(tgt.mask, bool)
cam = obs.camera("head")
d = np.asarray(cam.depth_m, float); K = np.asarray(cam.K, float); C2W = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world, float)
pw = G.transform_points(G.mask_to_cloud(d, K, mask), C2W)
print("cloud", len(pw))
top = pw[(pw[:,2] > 0.850) & (pw[:,2] < 0.868)]
cx, cy, r_top = circle_fit(top[:,:2])
print("top circle fit axis", round(cx,4), round(cy,4), "r", round(r_top,4), "n", len(top))
for lo in np.arange(0.763, 0.85, 0.01):
    sel = (pw[:,2] >= lo) & (pw[:,2] < lo+0.01)
    if sel.sum() < 10: continue
    a, b, rr = circle_fit(pw[sel,:2])
    print("  z %.3f n=%3d fit r=%.4f  d=%.4f ctr=(%.3f,%.3f)" % (lo, sel.sum(), rr, 2*rr, a, b))

# choose intercept
X_INT = 0.33
Y_C_INT = float(cy)
Z_PAD = 0.795
best = None
for th, sgn in [(45,-1),(50,-1),(40,-1),(55,-1),(45,1),(50,1)]:
    t = np.deg2rad(th)
    app = [sgn*np.sin(t), 0.0, -np.cos(t)]
    p = [X_INT, Y_C_INT, Z_PAD]
    fl = flange_for(p, app, [0,1,0])
    res = probe("right", [fl])[0]
    print("th", th, "sgn", sgn, "flange", np.round(fl[:3],3).tolist(), "reach", res.get("reachable"))
    if res.get("reachable") and best is None:
        best = (th, sgn, app, p, fl, res.get("position_error_m"))
if best is None:
    handoff("no feasible tilted grasp pose")
th, sgn, app, pad, fl, perr = best
print("CHOSEN", th, sgn, pad, fl)
p = Point(fl[:3], "world")
tg = target(p, approach=Direction(app, "world"), jaw_line=Direction([0,1,0], "world"), interaction="free_space")
dr = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": tg}, dry_run=True)
print("dry", dr.feasible, dr.summary)
if not dr.feasible:
    print(dr.explain)
    handoff("grasp positioning infeasible", summary=dr.summary)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": tg})
print("move", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, "err", r.target_error_m)

import numpy as np
from skimage import measure
from ora_lib import current
from ora_lib import geometry as G

BELT_Z, X_LO, X_HI, Y_LO, Y_HI = 0.7628, -0.72, 0.72, -0.25, 0.45

def clusters(camera="head", min_h=0.010, min_px=60):
    obs = current()
    cam = obs.camera(camera)
    d = np.asarray(cam.depth_m, float)
    K = np.asarray(cam.K, float); C2W = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world, float)
    h, w = d.shape
    uu, vv = np.meshgrid(np.arange(w), np.arange(h))
    valid = np.isfinite(d) & (d > 0.05) & (d < 2.0)
    zc = d[valid]
    xc = (uu[valid]-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*zc
    yc = (vv[valid]-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*zc
    pw = G.transform_points(np.stack([xc,yc,zc],axis=-1), C2W)
    u1, v1 = uu[valid], vv[valid]
    sel = ((pw[:,2] > BELT_Z+min_h) & (pw[:,2] < 1.25) &
           (pw[:,0] > X_LO) & (pw[:,0] < X_HI) & (pw[:,1] > Y_LO) & (pw[:,1] < Y_HI))
    m = np.zeros((h,w), bool); m[v1[sel], u1[sel]] = True
    lab = measure.label(m, connectivity=2)
    out = []
    for r in measure.regionprops(lab):
        if r.area < min_px: continue
        inside = np.zeros((h,w), bool); inside[r.coords[:,0], r.coords[:,1]] = True
        pick = sel & inside[v1, u1]
        pts = pw[pick]
        out.append(dict(area=int(r.area),
                        bbox=[int(r.bbox[1]),int(r.bbox[0]),int(r.bbox[3]),int(r.bbox[2])],
                        ctr=np.round(pts.mean(axis=0),4).tolist(),
                        xext=[float(pts[:,0].min()), float(pts[:,0].max())],
                        yext=[float(pts[:,1].min()), float(pts[:,1].max())],
                        zmax=float(pts[:,2].max())))
    return obs, out

def find_cup(camera="head", xmax=0.45):
    obs, cl = clusters(camera)
    cands = []
    for c in cl:
        hgt = c["zmax"] - BELT_Z
        wx = c["xext"][1]-c["xext"][0]; wy = c["yext"][1]-c["yext"][0]
        if 0.075 < hgt < 0.125 and wx < 0.135 and wy < 0.135 and c["ctr"][1] < 0.02 and c["ctr"][0] < xmax:
            c = dict(c); c["h"] = hgt
            cands.append(c)
    return obs, cl, cands

import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
from poses import flange_for, probe
from cupdet import find_cup, clusters, BELT_Z

ARM = "right"
LEAD_M = 0.014      # belt travel expected between close command and pad contact
TOL_M = 0.010       # allowed offset of the cup centre from the planned close point
V = None

# --- current gripper geometry (measured) ---
rf = current().robot_facts["end_effectors"][ARM]
flange = np.asarray(rf["pose_xyz_xyzw"][:3], float)
approach_w = np.asarray(rf["axes"]["approach_world"], float)
closing_w = np.asarray(rf["axes"]["closing_world"], float)
pad_now = flange + 0.1501*approach_w
print("gripper flange", flange.round(4).tolist(), "approach", approach_w.round(4).tolist(),
      "closing", closing_w.round(4).tolist(), "pad", pad_now.round(4).tolist())
PAD_X, PAD_Y, PAD_Z = float(pad_now[0]), float(pad_now[1]), float(pad_now[2])
grip = rf["gripper"]
print("opening", grip["measured_opening_normalized"])

def cup_x():
    o, cl, ca = find_cup()
    if not ca: return None, None
    c = min(ca, key=lambda c: abs(c["ctr"][1]-PAD_Y))
    return c["ctr"][0], c

x0, c0 = cup_x()
print("cup at", x0, None if c0 is None else (c0["ctr"], c0["h"]))
if x0 is None:
    handoff("cup not detected before grasp")
tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20)
x1, c1 = cup_x()
print("after 20 ticks cup at", x1)
if x1 is None or x1 <= x0:
    handoff("cup detection unreliable", x0=x0, x1=x1)
v = (x1-x0)/20.0
print("belt speed m/tick", round(v,5))

# --- dry run the lift first ---
lift_opts = []
for pz in [0.98, 0.95, 0.92]:
    for py in [-0.20, -0.14]:
        lift_opts.append([PAD_X, py, pz])
lift_pose = None
for pad in lift_opts:
    fl = flange_for(pad, approach_w, closing_w)
    p = Point(fl[:3], "world")
    tg = target(p, approach=Direction(approach_w, "world"), jaw_line=Direction(closing_w, "world"), interaction="free_space")
    try:
        dr = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tg}, dry_run=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print("lift dry exc", pad, type(e).__name__); continue
    print("lift dry", pad, dr.feasible, "|", dr.summary)
    if dr.feasible:
        lift_pose = (pad, tg); break
if lift_pose is None:
    handoff("no feasible lift pose")

# --- bring cup to the close point ---
target_close = PAD_X - LEAD_M
last = x1
for it in range(8):
    rem = target_close - last
    print("iter", it, "cup", round(last,4), "rem", round(rem,4))
    if rem <= 0.004: break
    n = int(round(rem/v))
    n = max(1, min(20, n))
    tools.wait_ticks(ticks=n)
    x, c = cup_x()
    if x is None:
        print("  lost cup after wait", n); break
    print("  waited", n, "-> cup", round(x,4), "dy", round(c["ctr"][1]-PAD_Y,4))
    last = x
err = target_close - last
print("final cup x", round(last,4), "target", round(target_close,4), "err", round(err,4))
if abs(err) > TOL_M:
    handoff("could not time the cup to the close point", cup_x=last, target=target_close, err=err)

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"})
print("close", r.ok, r.status, "measured_opening", r.measured_opening, "commanded", r.commanded_opening)
op = r.measured_opening
if op is None or float(op) < 0.45:
    handoff("jaws closed on nothing", opening=op)

pad, tg = lift_pose
lr = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tg})
print("lift", lr.ok, lr.status, lr.failure_code, "err", lr.target_error_m, "|", lr.summary)

# --- verify ---
obs, cl = clusters()
found = [c for c in cl if abs(c["ctr"][0]-PAD_X) < 0.09 and abs(c["ctr"][1]-PAD_Y) < 0.12 and c["ctr"][2] > 0.85]
print("verify clusters", [(c["ctr"], round(c["zmin"],3), round(c["zmax"],3)) for c in found])
if not found:
    handoff("cup not found above belt after lift", opening=op)
c = found[0]
print("cup lifted: zmin", round(c["zmin"],4), "bottom above belt", round(c["zmin"]-BELT_Z,4))
